launches.title: Prism: Lightning fast inference for coding agents
launches.body:
Hello everyone,

We’re Alex and Rajit, and we’re excited to launch Prism.

**TL;DR:** Prism is an inference cloud for open source LLMs. We use agents to optimize our deployments for cost, latency, and throughput (we serve DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at 547 tok/s).

<https://youtu.be/Tp8_JO_IvX4>

## The Problem

Open source models just got really good. DeepSeek was almost a quarter of all traffic on OpenRouter last week.

We spoke to developers building coding agents, personal AI assistants, and code review software, and we asked what the biggest bottleneck was in adopting open source models.

The answer: there is a token shortage. Existing providers either don’t have enough capacity, are too slow, or aren’t reliable enough.

## Meet Prism:

Introducing Prism: lightning fast inference for coding agents. We have three core ideas.

1. Custom deployments for every model

We use agents to optimize our deployments for latency, cost, and throughput. Here’s Deepseek V4.1 Flash running on Prism vs other major providers for the same coding task.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=116844&key=user_uploads/551584/62819c55-2169-4734-927b-8a0a1765e57b)

2. Price tokens like electricity

PG&E charges less for off-peak usage. Token providers should do the same. And not every LLM request is urgent. We can charge less for requests with a wider scheduling window.

3. Enable companies to develop personal intelligence

For domain-specific tasks, teams are adding adapters onto base models. Most providers require them to pay GPU costs, host, and run the model themselves. We offer serverless LoRA inference along with dedicated deployments.

## Ask

We’ve spoken to

1. teams who are doing more than six figures a month in frontier lab spend
2. teams whose inference providers slow down their products 
3. teams who are considering post-training their own models but don’t want to pay constant GPU costs

If those descriptions sound like you, book a call with us to see how we can help [cal.com/team/prismai/demo](http://cal.com/team/prismai/demo).

launches.title: Prism - AI for the Next Generation of Media
launches.tagline: Prism is a platform for making short form videos with AI
launches.body:
Hey Everyone! This is Rajit, Land, and Alex

**TL;DR:** Prism is an AI platform for creating short-form videos. Generate assets, build storyboards scene-by-scene, and edit everything in one place.

## **Who Prism is For**

Prism is for anyone who ships short-form regularly:

* **Creators** making memes, skits, explainer videos, ASMR videos, short films, etc.
* **Marketers & agencies** creating paid ads, launch videos, and UGC content

Prism is for anyone who wants to go viral:

* **Founders** aura-farming on LinkedIn with product launches.
* **Consumer/prosumer founders** who spend time on growth-hacking on TikTok when they’d rather be shipping.

## **The Problem**

Creating AI video content today means piecing together a dozen disconnected tools:

* Image generators for concept art
* Upscalers to make them usable
* Image-to-video generators to bring still images to life
* Start/end frame tools for precise scene control
* Lipsync tools to match audio
* Voiceover generators for narration
* Video editors to stitch it all together

Each tool operates separately, so you end up exporting from one and importing into another, then re-describing the same scene to try to keep things consistent. Over time, characters start to vary between clips, the visual style can drift, and the assets get spread across 10 browser tabs and your local drive.

## **Meet Prism:**

Prism is the entire video creation pipeline in one place.

Start with a project, set the style once, and build your story scene-by-scene. Generate images, upscale them, and transform them to animated clips with voiceovers and lipsync all in one platform.

No more exporting between tools or re-prompting every step. Your characters stay consistent, your settings carry over, and your full project context stays attached so every scene looks like it belongs in the same video.

[**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bMkQIP8NvdY**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bMkQIP8NvdY)

launches.title: Prism - AI that watches session replays and tells developers what to fix 🔍
launches.tagline: Prism helps product teams become customer obsessed.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We're [Alex](https://x.com/spicy_liu), [Land](https://x.com/LTantichot), and [Rajit](https://x.com/RajitWrites) - co-founders of [Prism](https://x.com/teamprismai).

# **TL;DR:**

Prism is an AI that watches session replays and tells developers what to fix.

https://youtu.be/xmvlRom8BNA

# **Problem**

At Rajit’s previous company, they built a new onboarding flow, set up a dashboard to analyze it, and realized that it was broken. The problem was that this realization came four months later.

This is the core insight that led us to start Prism.

Existing product analytics solutions are inflexible. They require comprehensive instrumentation and break every time an engineer adds a new flow or modifies an existing one.

With Prism, developers get insight into what's broken on day one. No event-tracking necessary.

# **Solution**

Prism uses vision models to watch session replays and identify friction. For our customers, it's like having a support engineer sit with every one of their users.

People get value from Prism in one of two ways.

### 1. Semantic search

_Rather than watching hundreds of hours of session replays, developers can ask “what are the main pain points users are experiencing?”_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90346&key=user_uploads/551584/e3e366c0-be08-4b7d-a351-dd8f6deea3f3)

### 2. Insight generation

_Prism identifies what the issue is, who’s experiencing it, and what a developer can do to resolve it._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90346&key=user_uploads/551584/fc5fd965-6693-45d1-ae61-a323920f205e)

# One more thing...

While building software may be increasingly commoditized, we believe that the relationship people have with their users will never be. Prism is an AI that enables our customers to know their users better than they know themselves.

If you want to become customer-obsessed, you can get started at [prismreplay.com](http://prismreplay.com).

You can also book a demo to chat with us at [cal.com/team/prismai/demo](http://cal.com/team/prismai/demo).
